mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) rows_seen,COALESCE(SUM(row_status IN ('IMPORTED','UPDATED','SKIPPED_DUPLICATE','SKIPPED_STALE')),0) completed,COALESCE(SUM(row_status IN ('IMPORTED','UPDATED')),0) imported_success,COALESCE(SUM(row_status='REVIEW_NEEDED'),0) reviewed,COALESCE(SUM(row_status IN ('INVALID','FAILED')),0) invalid_rows,COALESCE(SUM(row_status='SKIPPED_DUPLICATE'),0) duplicate_rows,COALESCE(SUM(row_status='SKIPPED_STALE'),0) stale_rows,COALESCE(SUM(quality_error_code='REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING'),0) required_errors,COALESCE(SUM(quality_error_code='INVALID_TIME'),0) time_errors,COALESCE(SUM(quality_error_code LIKE 'UNMAPPED_%'),0) enum_errors FROM t_import_row WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND record_type='ROW'
SELECT COUNT(*) attachment_total,COALESCE(SUM(final_status='AVAILABLE'),0) attachment_available FROM t_import_row WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND record_type='ATTACHMENT_TASK'
